en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Remove connector in Claude Tag admin settings being refused when access bundles also held its credentials; it now removes those set on the connector and leaves the bundles' own
zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了当访问捆绑包也持有 connector 的凭据时，Claude Tag 管理设置中的移除 connector 操作被拒绝的问题；现在会移除在 connector 上设置的凭据，并保留捆绑包自身的凭据
